text: Both of you pledged to take the high road in this campaign yet it has turned very nasty
speaker: SCHIEFFER

text: Senator Obama, your campaign has used words like "erratic," "out of touch," "lie," "angry," "losing his bearings" to describe Senator McCain
speaker: SCHIEFFER

text: Senator McCain, your commercials have included words like "disrespectful," "dangerous," "dishonorable," "he lied."
speaker: SCHIEFFER

text: Your running mate said he "palled around with terrorists."
speaker: SCHIEFFER
